Task: Locate the anchor function for the state_code field in the console.log object whose action is inventory.snapshot after configuring the inventory board (zone, window, batch, seal hold), selecting inventory row bin-219, and clicking Snapshot. The anchor function is the first target-specific state encoding value constructor on the dynamic behavior chain: after two-stage row selection, intent routing, board-state collection, tuple input preparation and runtime state normalization, its function body itself constructs the target observable state encoding value rather than merely collecting inputs, dispatching control, wrapping a return value, or writing to the console. Return exactly one complete function as a single JSON object (see answer_format). Do not return generic utilities, event handlers, the full call chain, or the final sink. Note: you may only inspect code under captures;

}
